description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter class, focusing on its reset functionality and counter value correctness within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.monitoring.metrics package.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionMetricsCounterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter, particularly the reset functionality and correctness of success/failure counters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DefaultConnectionMetricsCounter instance before each test.

methods.name: testResetCounter
methods.description: Tests the reset functionality of the counter, validating counts before and after reset.

methods.name: recordCounterValues
methods.description: Records a number of success and failure events to the counter.

methods.name: assertCounterValues
methods.description: Asserts that the counter has expected success and failure counts.
